title: 走れメロス (Hashire Merosu / Run, Melos!)
description: A shepherd named Melos is sentenced to death by a tyrannical king. He is given three days to attend his sister's wedding on the condition that his friend Selinuntius stays behind as his hostage. The story is a test of trust, friendship, and keeping one's word against all odds. One of the most famous Japanese short stories, assigned reading for most Japanese middle and high school students.
author: 太宰治
